coordinate_system.origin: standard initial position on calibrated court plane
coordinate_system.positive_x: horizontal from initial position toward net center
coordinate_system.target_axis: fixed unit vector from calibrated nominal impact center to fixed target center

events.ground_contact: resultant vertical GRF above 20 N for at least 10 ms
events.contact: first visible shuttle-stringbed contact frame in synchronized video at 1000 fps or higher

primary_outcome.metric: mean racket-head ground-frame velocity projected onto fixed target unit vector

manipulation_checks.backward_com: mean v_CoM dot (-X) in GC-20 ms to GC+20 ms
manipulation_checks.failure_rule: report ITT estimate and manipulation failure; do not relabel trials or claim causal discrimination

mechanistic_windows.early: GC to midpoint of GC-contact interval
mechanistic_windows.late: midpoint of GC-contact interval to contact-10 ms

exclusion_principles.primary_participant_requirement: at least one valid primary outcome in every assigned cell
exclusion_principles.complete_dose_sensitivity: at least four valid trials in every cell

unresolved_before_seal: interaction priority and final sample size
confirmatory data cutoff and sealed prediction hash
